name: Box
summary: Cloud content management and file sharing for businesses.

flows.title: Upload files or a folder
steps: In Files, click the New + button in the upper-right corner.
Select File Upload or Folder Upload.
Select the files or the folder. Hold Command or Control to select several files; only one folder can be chosen at a time.

flows.title: Create a shared link
steps: In the files view, hover over the row of the file or folder to share.
On the right, click Copy Shared Link (Create and Copy Shared Link if it has none yet).
The Shared Link window opens and the link is copied to the clipboard.

flows.title: Move or copy a file or folder
steps: Right-click the file or folder and click Move or Copy.
Find the destination folder, scrolling or opening folders as needed.
Click anywhere in that folder's row.
